attchmntText: Adani Exports Ltd has informed the Exchange that at the Board Meeting held on May 20,2006 the following items were deliberated and agreed upon subject to various formalities and approvals - 1) The Board discussed at length its overall business model comprising of the following SBUs : a) "Energy" Group, b) "Agro" Group, c) "Metals" Group, d) "Real Estate Group". It was generally agreed that the Adani Group's several initiatives for these SBUs would be structured under a appropriate division/subsidiary of Adani Exports Limited, subject to various approvals and formalities. This would present an integrated profile of each SBU in its entire value chain, under the overall structure of Adani Exports Limited. 2) The Real Estate Group has taken large initiatives in the cities of Mumbai and Ahmedabad aggregating to about 25 million square feet of development envisaging a product mix of township and integrated complexes of retail, commercial and residential units. The Real Estate initiatives under Adani Exports Limited would be through separate "special purpose vehicles" structure.
